subject: Mutual Action Plan: security ticklist, deliverables & commitment
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: security@meridianpay.com, Legal Ops <legalops@meridianpay.com>, CFO, MeridianPay <cfo@meridianpay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: security ticklist, deliverables & commitment

Hi all,

Thanks for the productive call this morning. Per request, attached is a first-cut Mutual Action Plan (Meridian_MAP_v1.xlsx) that lays out the security/compliance gates and owners we discussed: SOC 2 attestation, SIG/CAIQ snapshot, DPA redlines, and data retention windows for logs and backups. High-level timeline is in the first tab and a detailed ticklist on tab 2.

Key asks from our side that would help speed evaluation:
- Confirm your acceptance criteria for SOC 2 (Type II vs Type I, required controls) — will assume Type II for MAP timeline.
- Flag any absolute deal blockers in the DPA redline you just started.
- Confirm retention windows required for transaction logs, audit logs, and backups (we've used 90 days / 365 days / 7 years as placeholders).

Proposed milestone cadence (subject to your feedback):
1) MAP ack + DPA redline review due: 2028-08-30
2) SIG/CAIQ snapshot delivery (we'll attach a filled CAIQ): 2028-08-31
3) SOC 2 evidence handoff / staging for you to review: target 2028-09-10
4) Decision & PO: target 2028-09-20

I've copied Laura (security ops) and Mina (legal enablement) who will drive the evidence and contract follow-ups. Please let us know who from your team will own acceptance decisions (security owner + procurement contact).

Attachments: Meridian_MAP_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: Legal Ops <legalops@meridianpay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: security@meridianpay.com, cfo@meridianpay.com
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: security ticklist, deliverables & commitment

Jonas — thanks for the MAP and draft timeline. We reviewed the spreadsheet and attached a SIG snapshot (SIG_snapshot_20280823.pdf) and our initial DPA redlines (DPA_redlines_v3.docx). A couple of quick points from Legal Ops/security:

- DPA: we're marking two items as high priority for us to close before PO: (1) data residency confirmation for EU customers, (2) liability cap carveout for regulated payment data. Redlines are commented in the doc.
- Retention: our compliance baseline requires transaction audit trails retained for 3 years and immutable backups for 7 years. Can you confirm Redwood's standard options and any add-on pricing?
- SOC: we need to understand whether you have a recurring attestation cadence and if you’re comfortable sharing the most recent SOC 2 Type II report under NDA.

We can pivot timeline once we have your answers on retention and the SOC attestation availability.

— Meridian Legal Ops (on behalf of MeridianPay)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Legal Ops <legalops@meridianpay.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, security@meridianpay.com
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 13:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: security ticklist, deliverables & commitment

Hi Meridian team — Laura here (Security Ops). A few specifics to clarify and commit to from Redwood's side: 

1) SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation on an annual cadence. The most recent report covers the period through 2028-06-30. We can share the report under the standard NDA we use for customers; I'll loop in our trust team to start the share (expect delivery by 2028-08-28).

2) SIG/CAIQ: attached CAIQ and SIG snapshot outline all control mappings we typically provide. If you want specific control narrative for billing/audit trails we can add a short appendix by 2028-08-30.

3) Data retention: our platform supports per-customer retention settings. Standard options we offer out-of-the-box are:
   - Audit & transaction logs: 90 days (default) / 365 days / custom up to 3 years (paid tier)
   - Immutable backups (for regulatory/legal hold): 7 years (add-on)
   - Full data residency (US-only or EU-only) is available on Redwood Private deployments — for hosted customers we offer EU-region hosting upon agreement.

Given Meridian's ask for 3 years for audit trails, we can accommodate this via a retention policy upgrade (I note that this is a billable configuration; Mina can provide the pricing line).

4) Owners / next steps:
   - Redwood owner for evidence handoff: Laura Bennett (security) — I'll lead SOC artifact packaging.
   - Redwood owner for DPA redlines: Mina Haddad (legal enablement) — Mina will review the doc and propose counter-redlines by 2028-08-25.

I'll attach our evidence checklist and a short SOC evidence index into the MAP folder.

Laura Bennett
Security Ops — Redwood Inference
From: CFO, MeridianPay <cfo@meridianpay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: legalops@meridianpay.com, security@meridianpay.com
Date: Thu, 23 Aug 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: security ticklist, deliverables & commitment

Laura — appreciate the quick confirmation. Two follow-ups from our procurement side:

- Can you confirm whether the 3-year audit trail retention option requires Redwood Private or if it can be toggled for a hosted account? If togglable, please include the monthly incremental cost estimate.
- For the SOC 2 report: we will sign the standard NDA today if that speeds delivery — please send NDA link.

Also, we want to align on a soft-go/no-go milestone in the MAP: after we receive SOC evidence and the SIG narrative (target dates you listed), we'll have a 5-business-day window to raise any final blockers before PO issuance. Please confirm that window in the MAP.

Thanks — Alex (CFO)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: cfo@meridianpay.com, legalops@meridianpay.com, security@meridianpay.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2028 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: security ticklist, deliverables & commitment

Alex / Meridian team — thanks for the feedback and the redlines. Quick commitments from Redwood so we have an agreed MAP for signatures: 

- SOC 2 report: we will share the 2028-06-30 SOC 2 Type II via NDA link by end of day 2028-08-24.
- Retention: the 3-year audit trail retention is available for hosted accounts as a configuration (no Private deployment required). Mina will attach pricing in the MAP worksheet and include billable SKU.
- DPA: Mina expects to deliver counter-redlines by 2028-08-25; we can target final DPA sign-off by 2028-09-07 assuming no new substantive carveouts.
- Soft go / decision window: confirmed — Meridian will have 5 business days after evidence delivery (SOC + SIG narrative) to raise final blockers. We'll mark that as the acceptance window in the MAP (row: Acceptance Window = 5bd).

Next actions: 
1) Mina Haddad (cc) will upload a DPA counter and pricing lines to the shared Drive by 2028-08-25.
2) Laura to share SOC package under NDA by 2028-08-28.
3) Jonas to update the MAP with acceptance-window and send DocuSign intent link once DPA counters are in (target 2028-08-26).

If these dates work, please reply with a short ack. Once we have your ack I'll circulate the DocuSign link and lock the MAP milestone dates.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
